We dug into the tenant policy bundle. Quick summary: during today's config generation a decay/burst_window parameter for the "api_pacing" policy got an incorrect multiplier (ms vs s). The burst window used for token-bucket refills ended up 30000 ms (30s) instead of 300 ms. That causes a much slower refill on short bursts, effectively starving legitimate short, frequent requests and producing 429s under steady load patterns.

Evidence:
- Policy snapshot id: policy-20261005-09:05 (rolled at 09:05)
- Diff: api_pacing.burst_window: 30000 (new) vs 300 (previous)
- Local repro: toggling burst_window to 300 restores p95 latency to baseline in our staging sim.

Immediate mitigation steps I recommend:
1) Rollback policy snapshot policy-20261005-09:05 for tenant novus-768 (hotfix rollback).
2) Temporarily increase emergency quota for their primary route to absorb queued requests while rollback completes.
3) Patch the config generator to validate units (ms vs s) before rollout.

I'll prepare a rollback script and can run it if ops authorizes.

—Marcus
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
